// ES5 source. The compiler emits the project's own text instruction format.
function Counter(start) {
  this.value = start;
}
Counter.prototype.next = function (step) {
  this.value += step;
  return this.value;
};
function LoggedCounter(start) {
  Counter.call(this, start);
}
LoggedCounter.prototype = Object.create(Counter.prototype);
LoggedCounter.prototype.constructor = LoggedCounter;
var counter = new LoggedCounter(10);
var advance = counter.next.bind(counter, 2);
console.log(
  [1, 2, 3]
    .map(function () {
      return advance();
    })
    .join(','),
);
console.log(counter instanceof Counter);
console.log(counter instanceof LoggedCounter);
function guarded(value) {
  try {
    if (value < 0) throw new RangeError('negative');
    return value * 2;
  } catch (error) {
    return error.name;
  } finally {
    console.log('finally:' + value);
  }
}
console.log(guarded(3));
console.log(guarded(-1));
outer: for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  try {
    for (var j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
      if (i === 0) continue outer;
      if (i === 2) break outer;
      console.log('pair:' + i + ':' + j);
    }
  } finally {
    console.log('loop-finally:' + i);
  }
}
function makeCounter() {
  var count = 0;
  return function () {
    try {
      return ++count;
    } finally {
      console.log('callback:' + count);
    }
  };
}
console.log([1, 2].map(makeCounter()).join(','));
